name: react-native-vision-camera
description: 📸 A powerful, high-performance React Native Camera library.

issues.title: 🛠️ (iOS) Not possible to build for simulator with react-native-vision-camera-barcode-scanner on iOS 26
🛠️ (iOS) iOS build fails: 'React/RCTMessageThread.h' file not found when building VisionCameraWorklets (when using react-native-vision-camera-worklets)
✨  Allow audio processing similar to frame processing
🐛 [Android] Each FrameOutput leaks its native thread (dispose() doesn't shut down the executor; useFrameOutput never disposes)
🐛 convertCameraPointToFramePoint ignores normalising extents on orientation swap (iOS) — square region maps to a 3.16:1 strip
🐛 CameraOrientation.fromDegrees() has LEFT/RIGHT swapped on Android — doesn't round-trip its own .degrees getter
🐛 [Android] Cannot capture RAW using .capturePhotoToFile() if permission is granted in the same launch of app

latest_release.name: Release 5.2.4
latest_release.body:
## [5.2.4](https://github.com/margelo/react-native-vision-camera/compare/v5.2.3...v5.2.4) (2026-10-29)

### ✨ Features

* Add native tap-to-focus lifecycle listeners ([#4172](https://github.com/margelo/react-native-vision-camera/issues/4172)) ([050ceac](https://github.com/margelo/react-native-vision-camera/commit/050ceac1148ac8ef8287b4c2a3f5eeb27e207d20))
* Add native zoom gesture change listener ([#4171](https://github.com/margelo/react-native-vision-camera/issues/4171)) ([3becbfd](https://github.com/margelo/react-native-vision-camera/commit/3becbfdad235db58d59ecab0e6b56f2e219796f3))
* expose metadata from capturePhotoToFile ([#4170](https://github.com/margelo/react-native-vision-camera/issues/4170)) ([1ca9b7b](https://github.com/margelo/react-native-vision-camera/commit/1ca9b7bb70f486cabfb0156f4f1867749ee25f4b))

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* Deep-compare `constraints` instead of `JSON.stringify`-ing them ([#4167](https://github.com/margelo/react-native-vision-camera/issues/4167)) ([8015396](https://github.com/margelo/react-native-vision-camera/commit/8015396b408c370f47bf89cfcf8ee7ad0cef17cd))
* Memoize `targetResolution` in output hooks ([#4166](https://github.com/margelo/react-native-vision-camera/issues/4166)) ([2ae908a](https://github.com/margelo/react-native-vision-camera/commit/2ae908abc69b799b738f672f0056a7b6424707ee))
* prevent CameraX executor starvation ([#4218](https://github.com/margelo/react-native-vision-camera/issues/4218)) ([1a69f29](https://github.com/margelo/react-native-vision-camera/commit/1a69f290e1a4308d3fb9bec0a02acb55355005a8))
